items.title: A standard covering is refined by a single fpqc covering with the same Cech complex
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma replaces a standard tau-covering of a scheme by a single covering with the same Cech complex: the disjoint union V of the members is affine, the one-element family {V -> U} is an fpqc covering and a tau-covering except for Zariski, and the two Cech complexes agree (statement lines 2166-2183). The proof verifies affineness from the definition of a standard covering (proof lines 2185-2204), checks the covering properties of V -> U (proof lines 2204-2218), and compares the complexes by exhibiting refinement maps in both directions (proof lines 2207-2232). The non-formal content is the mutual refinement of the two coverings. The claim is H2: three short verifications.
